title: Black Bottle Product Reel
tests: Tests turning an attached product photo into one coherent 15-second vertical ad while preserving product identity.

faults.what: The required “Shop now” ending is absent from the supplied ending frame.
The lid's top handle changes noticeably between the opening and later views, from a compact cylindrical-looking top to a broad open loop, compromising product consistency.

judge.summary: The 15-second vertical ad provides clean studio product close-ups, but the misspelled opening, missing closing call to action, and inconsistent lid require a redo.

must_haves.item: One playable 9:16 ad runs for approximately 15 seconds, not just a single clip of 10 seconds or less.
must_haves.why: The supplied output is identified as a 15-second MP4, with portrait frames spanning the runtime.

must_haves.item: The featured product matches the supplied matte black bottle, including its silhouette and lid.
must_haves.why: The matte black body and overall silhouette are similar, but the lid handle is not faithfully maintained across the views.

must_haves.item: The ad includes multiple moving product views or close-ups in a clean studio setting.
must_haves.why: The sampled sequence shows full-bottle views, a lid close-up, and a lower-body close-up against a clean neutral studio background.

must_haves.item: The opening reads exactly “Your everyday bottle” and the ending reads exactly “Shop now”.
must_haves.why: The opening reads “Your eveyady bottle”; no “Shop now” is visible in the supplied ending view.

must_haves.item: Mellow music is audible and there is no spoken voice.
must_haves.why: The sound report confirms no clear speech and indicates music or ambience, but does not establish that the audio is mellow music.
